{{Top|leg}}
A '''guidance package''' was part of the [[PLX-2]] [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. [[Chop Harlison]] used the PLX2's guidance package, in conjunction with [[field manipulator]]s, as part of the design for the [[Star Slinger]] prototype [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]].
